theme: An open day — good for the overdue few.
greeting: The calendar is nearly clear, Dan, with just a birthday reminder this evening. The real pull today is a short stack of overdue essentials that only get more expensive to leave.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV — hold it refundable
needsAttention.detail: Overdue since Sept 14 in Todoist (p1). A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out; a refundable booking held now costs nothing and takes the whole risk off the table.

needsAttention.title: Reschedule the passport appointment
needsAttention.detail: Overdue Sept 21 in Todoist (p1). Now that you are back from the Sept 20 return, rebook the four minor appointments — books already land early-to-mid November, so every week of slip presses harder on the December-trip timeline.

needsAttention.title: Call the dermatologist for Mike
needsAttention.detail: Overdue Aug 28 in Todoist (p2). New-patient derm waits run weeks, so the booking date matters more than the procedure — worth clearing on the same phone sitting as the passports.

schedule.title: Julia's birthday
schedule.detail: A birthday reminder on your calendar

flagged.title: AbeBooks account activity
flagged.detail: A sign-in attempt, several password-reset emails, and a password change this morning — all from Florida on an iPhone alongside your book order, so most likely you. Worth a glance to be sure.

flagged.title: Venmo request — $50
flagged.detail: Joshua Weaver's reminder for mowing (9/17) is still open.

flagged.title: LinkedIn alert: public-policy roles
flagged.detail: New 'SVP, Global Public Policy' and similar postings matched your saved alert.

inbox.noise: The rest is retail and newsletters — Faherty, Union Square Wines, Moleskine, a Disney survey.

resolved.title: Toronto panel — you're moderating
resolved.detail: You accepted ICGN's invitation to moderate a panel session; Elizabeth Thomas is sending speaker logistics and setting up a pre-conference call.

recipe.title: White sweet potato soup with pickled scallions
recipe.why: Autumn's first roots and cool evenings are made for a slow, from-scratch pot.

acts.line: A blank calendar — the day's real work is the short list of overdue essentials, not meetings.
Still wide open — a clean window to close the Maine rental and the passport reschedule.
Julia's birthday at five is the only fixed point, and an easy landing.
